matches.finish: Jimmy Sartyr pinned Scott Adams with a twisting splash after a top-rope frankensteiner.
Tyrone Walker pinned Ryan Chase, using the tights, after hitting him with brass knuckles while the referee was down.
Rage pinned Indigo Phoenix with a spiked piledriver; Ricky Chambers broke up the count a split second late.
Eric Dane pinned Skorp with the Star Driver.
Paul Blair won the main event after Chris Osbourne attacked both men with a chair.

matches.stipulation: World Heavyweight title tournament, round one
matches.finish: Mike Sloan rolled up Chris Osbourne, using the tights, while Dan Lynch was outside the ring.

matches.stipulation: World Heavyweight title tournament, round one
matches.finish: Eric Dane won and advanced.

matches.finish: Rage pinned The Poltergeist with a spiked piledriver.

matches.stipulation: World Heavyweight title tournament, with Jeff Jericho as special guest referee
matches.finish: Special guest referee Jeff Jericho made a fast count to give Jimmy Sartyr the win and eliminate Lu Yen from the tournament.
Blood attacked all three with a sledgehammer and a bag of tacks before a fall; the page records no result.
Larry Tact won in convincing fashion.
Dan Lynch handled both men and won the three-way.

matches.stipulation: World Heavyweight title tournament, round two
matches.finish: Mike Sloan beat Rage with the Scorned after Rage's superkick missed.
Mike Sloan hit Eric Dane with a chair as Dane set up the Star Driver and the referee signalled for the bell; the page does not rule a winner.
Johnny Keel narrowly beat Jimmy Sartyr to advance in the tournament.
Tyrone Walker pinned Paul Blair after Eric Dane hit Blair with the Star Driver and laid Walker on top of him while the official was down.

matches.stipulation: number one contendership for the Mid-Atlantic title
matches.finish: Chiron Cross beat Larry Tact; the winner earned the right to face the Mid-Atlantic champion at Summer Smash.
Dan Lynch beat Lu Yen to become the CWF Mid-Atlantic Champion.

matches.stipulation: CWF National title, scheduled as a four-way with Rage and Ricky Chambers
matches.finish: Rage was beaten up backstage by Blood and Ricky Chambers left to run an errand for Mark Xamin, leaving the four-way as Sartyr against Blair; Maniac hit Blair with the Headhunter and laid Sartyr on top of him, and Jimmy Sartyr became the CWF National Champion.
Tyrone Walker pinned Johnny Keel after Erik Olson interfered and the two hit the Broken Arrow and Got Milk.
Eric Dane pinned Mike Sloan with the Star Driver 2.0.

matches.finish: Tony Floyd won his CWF debut with the Bomb From Hell.
Chiron Cross made Ricky Chambers tap out.

matches.stipulation: CWF Mid-Atlantic title, no disqualification, falls count anywhere
matches.finish: Dan Lynch won and retained the Mid-Atlantic title.
Erik Olson hit both men with a chair and the match was ruled a double knockout with no winner; Jimmy Sartyr kept the title.

matches.stipulation: Team Danger against Blair and Sloan
matches.finish: Paul Blair and Mike Sloan won when Blair covered Walker and Sloan covered Dane outside the ring and the referee made a slow count.

matches.finish: Onyx won.
Chiron Cross won the three-way.
Ricky Chambers pinned Chemical X with Canadian Chaos after hitting Tony Floyd with it.
Mid-Atlantic champion Dan Lynch beat National champion Jimmy Sartyr; the referee missed Lynch's feet on the ropes.
Paul Blair pinned Eric Dane with the Blair Kick; Mike Sloan was hurt early in the match.

matches.stipulation: gauntlet match for the number one contendership to the National title
matches.finish: Chemical X won the gauntlet and the number one contendership to the National title; Chris Reinhardt was too drunk to compete and Blood did not appear for his draw.
Ricky Chambers won.
matches.stipulation: number one contendership for the Mid-Atlantic title

matches.finish: Chiron Cross won by disqualification; Dan Lynch kept the Mid-Atlantic title.
Lu Yen beat Jeff Jericho after GPW set up Maniac, the special referee, and took him out of the match.

matches.stipulation: number one contendership for the World Heavyweight title
matches.finish: Paul Blair won and became the number one contender to the World Heavyweight title.

matches.stipulation: Hell in a Cell, with Maniac in Xamin's corner
matches.finish: Paul Blair, with Triple X revealed as his corner man, beat Mark Xamin after throwing him off the top of the cell and Blair Kicking a chair into his head.
Tyrone Walker beat former partner Eric Dane to become the CWF World Heavyweight Champion.
Paul Blair cashed in his number one contender clause on the drained Walker and became the CWF World Heavyweight Champion.

Jason Collins won.

Blood won.
Chiron Cross escaped the cage to win.

matches.finish: Sam Banx pinned Vinny Williams.

matches.stipulation: five man ladder match for a briefcase hung above the ring
matches.finish: Larry Tact retrieved the briefcase hanging above the ring, which held the CWF Unified title, and became the Unified Champion.
Ricky Chambers and Chiron Cross won by disqualification; Blood then attacked Cross with a crowbar.
The referee stopped the match and gave it to Chemical X after Walker's neck was injured.

matches.stipulation: five man elimination match for the number one contendership to the Mid-Atlantic title
matches.finish: Kris Lewis won the five-man elimination and became the number one contender to the Mid-Atlantic title.
Blood pinned Chiron Cross after Blood Lust and the Legend Killer, then Magnus Thunder returned and Thunderstormed Blood.
Ricky Chambers pinned Dan Lynch with Canadian Chaos to become the CWF Mid-Atlantic Champion.
Jason Collins pinned Larry Tact with the Reality Check from the middle rope to become the CWF Unified Champion.
Chemical X retained the CWF National title.

matches.stipulation: the winner becomes the sole commissioner of the CWF
matches.finish: Jeff Jericho beat Maniac and became the sole commissioner of the CWF.

matches.stipulation: CWF World Heavyweight title, loser leaves town
matches.finish: Paul Blair retained the CWF World Heavyweight title.

matches.finish: Tony Floyd won.
Paul Nycz pinned Ginsu.
Kris Lewis and Ricky Chambers won.
Tony Floyd beat Jason Collins, after interference from Larry Tact, to become the CWF Unified Champion.
Chemical X retained the National title with help from Angus.

Jason Collins attacked Larry Tact just after the opening bell; the announcer began to give the match to Tact by disqualification, but a co-president cut him off and ordered a Collins-Tact rematch for the following week.

matches.finish: Mr. Kool pinned Talon Frost.
Ricky Chambers retained the Mid-Atlantic title after Kris Lewis helped while the referee was down.
Kris Lewis pinned Unified champion Tony Floyd with the Canadian Crunch.
Chemical X pinned Dan Lynch with the Three Piece.
Paul Blair pinned Magnus Thunder after Blood held Thunder's feet.

matches.stipulation: number one contendership for the World Heavyweight title
matches.finish: The number one contendership match ended without a winner and Jeff Jericho and Paul Blair joined a brawl with Blood, Tact, Collins and Magnus Thunder.

matches.finish: Bjay Williams won his debut match with the Ghetto Rock.
Apocalypticus won his debut with the Cataclysm.
Kris Lewis climbed the ladder to take the flag and win for Canadian Made.
Chemical X won with the Three Piece and retained the National title, then kicked Mr. Kool after offering a handshake.
Paul Blair won by count-out after Robin Cradle distracted the referee and a Blair Kick sent Floyd over the ropes.
Magnus Thunder won the fatal four-way with a second Thunderstorm on Blood.

date.source: the results page; the site-updates log of 19 January 2006 says the Brawl results were posted that day, and the card page gives 8 January 2006 as the show date

matches.finish: David Jones pinned Dan Lynch with the Jones Driver after hitting him with steel chairs while the referee was down.
Angus pinned Wrec Hannibal.
Kris Lewis won the first of three beat-the-clock matches for the last spot in Last Man Standing.
Magnus Thunder won in 9:52, the fastest time so far.
Ricky Chambers won in 9:53, one second too slow to take the last spot.

matches.stipulation: National title, as the page bills it
matches.finish: Angus and Magnus Thunder interrupted and both men left the ring to chase them, so the match ended in a double count-out.
Magnus Thunder and Keith Daniels won the tornado tag match, Thunder with a Thunderstorm on Jeff Jericho and Daniels with his finisher on Paul Blair, before the roster joined a brawl.
